ai.literal: Army, subjects, wealth, ministers, allies, fort - all six / he who possesses / among kings / is a lion.
ai.translation: He who possesses all six—an army, citizens, wealth, ministers, allies, and a fort—is a lion among kings.
ai.modern: படை, குடிமக்கள், செல்வம், அமைச்சர்கள், நண்பர்கள், அரண் ஆகிய ஆறு அங்கங்களையும் முழுமையாக உடையவன் அரசர்களுக்குள் சிங்கம் போன்றவன் ஆவான்.
ai.explanation: This couplet lists the six essential pillars of a strong state: a military force, a loyal populace, economic resources, wise ministers, reliable allies, and fortified defenses. The word 'கூழ்' literally means food, but is used here in the broader sense of wealth or national resources. The word 'ஏறு' refers to a male animal, such as a majestic bull or lion, and is used metaphorically to denote a supreme leader; thus, a ruler who successfully commands all six of these elements stands out as a mighty chief among kings.

ai.literal: Fearlessness, generosity, wisdom, zeal, these four all, unfailingness, to a king, nature.
ai.translation: Fearlessness, generosity, wisdom, and zeal—never lacking in these four is the nature of a king.
ai.modern: அஞ்சாமை, ஈகை, அறிவு, ஊக்கம் ஆகிய இந்த நான்கு பண்புகளும் சிறிதும் குறையாமல் நிலைத்திருப்பது ஒரு அரசனுக்குரிய இயல்பாகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the four essential qualities of a successful ruler. They are courage to face challenges, generosity to support the people, wisdom to make right decisions, and the drive to execute them. The word 'எஞ்சாமை' emphasizes that a true leader must possess all these four traits constantly and without any deficiency.

ai.literal: Vigilance, learning, possessing decisiveness, these three depart not from those who rule the earth.
ai.translation: Vigilance, learning, and decisiveness—these three qualities never depart from those who rule the earth.
ai.modern: காலம் தாழ்த்தாத சுறுசுறுப்பு, சிறந்த கல்வி, முடிவெடுக்கும் துணிவு ஆகிய இந்த மூன்றும் நாட்டை ஆளும் தலைவர்களிடம் இருந்து விலகாமல் இருக்க வேண்டும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet outlines three essential qualities for a successful ruler. 'தூங்காமை' means vigilance or acting without delay, 'கல்வி' is continuous learning, and 'துணிவுடைமை' is the boldness to make firm decisions. The poet states that these three traits must never depart ('நீங்கா') from those who govern the land, as they are the foundation of effective leadership.

ai.literal: Virtue without-failing, non-virtuous-things having-removed, valor unfailing honor that-which-possesses [is] king.
ai.translation: A true king is one who never fails in virtue, eradicates evil, and possesses honor backed by unfailing valor.
ai.modern: அறத்திலிருந்து தவறாமல், தீயவற்றை நாட்டை விட்டு நீக்கி, வீரத்தில் குறையாத மானத்தை உடையதே சிறந்த அரசாகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the essential qualities of a good ruler. A king must steadfastly uphold virtue and actively eradicate evil from his realm. Furthermore, he must possess a deep sense of honor that is backed by unwavering courage. The words for virtue and valor are paired to show that moral righteousness and martial strength must coexist to protect the state.

ai.literal: Producing and, collecting and, protecting and, the protected distributing and, capable is the king.
ai.translation: A true king is capable of creating sources of wealth, collecting it, protecting it, and properly distributing what has been protected.
ai.modern: பொருள் வரும் வழிகளை உருவாக்குவதும், பொருளைச் சேர்ப்பதும், சேர்த்ததைக் காப்பதும், காத்த பொருளைப் பிரித்துச் செலவிடுவதும் ஆகிய செயல்களில் வல்லதே சிறந்த அரசாகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet outlines the four essential economic duties of a ruler. First, 'இயற்றல்' means creating or facilitating sources of wealth. Second, 'ஈட்டல்' is the collection and accumulation of that wealth into the treasury. Third, 'காத்தல்' involves guarding the gathered wealth from loss, while 'வகுத்தல்' means properly distributing the protected wealth for the public good. A state is defined by its capability to perform all four of these sequential tasks effectively.

ai.literal: To sight easy man, harsh-worded man if he is not, will highly praise king land.
ai.translation: If a king is easy to access and free from harsh words, the world will highly praise his land.
ai.modern: காண்பதற்கு எளிமையானவனாகவும், கடுமையான சொற்களைப் பேசாதவனாகவும் ஒரு மன்னன் இருந்தால், அவனது நாட்டை உலகம் மிகவும் புகழ்ந்து பேசும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines two essential qualities of a great ruler: accessibility and gentle speech. The phrase 'காட்சிக்கு எளியன்' means the king is easy to approach and does not isolate himself from his people. The phrase 'கடுஞ்சொல்லன் அல்லனேல்' means he does not use harsh or abusive words. When a ruler possesses these two virtues, the entire world will look up to and highly praise his land.

ai.literal: With sweet words having given to protect to those who are able, by his own word he envisioned-all-that this world.
ai.translation: For a leader who can give generously and protect with sweet words, this world becomes exactly what they envision through their command.
ai.modern: இனிய சொற்களைப் பேசி, தானும் கொடுத்து, பிறரைக் காப்பாற்ற வல்லவருக்கு, இந்த உலகம் அவர் தன் சொல்லால் நினைத்தபடியே அமையும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet explains the profound influence of a benevolent leader. When a ruler gives generously and protects the people while speaking sweet words ('இன்சொலால்'), they earn absolute loyalty. Because of this willing devotion, the entire world ('இவ்வுலகு') will shape itself exactly as the leader envisions ('கண்டனைத்து') simply through their command ('தன்சொலால்').

ai.literal: Justice having done who protects king, to the people god saying to be placed will be.
ai.translation: A king who administers justice and protects his subjects will be considered a god to his people.
ai.modern: நீதியுடன் ஆட்சி செய்து மக்களைக் காப்பாற்றும் மன்னவன், மக்களுக்கு ஒரு தெய்வமாகவே கருதப்படுவான்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the highest standard for a ruler. The phrase 'முறை செய்து' means administering justice properly and maintaining order. When a king combines this strict justice with the active protection of his subjects, he elevates his status. Because of these divine qualities of justice and protection, the people will look up to him and consider him a god.

ai.literal: Ear to-be-bitter words bearing quality possessing king's umbrella under will-stay world.
ai.translation: The world will abide beneath the umbrella of a king who has the character to endure words that are bitter to the ear.
ai.modern: தன் செவிக்குக் கசப்பாக இருக்கும் அறிவுரைகளையும் பொறுத்துக்கொள்ளும் பண்புடைய அரசனின் குடையின் கீழ்தான் உலகம் தங்கியிருக்கும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet describes the essential quality of a great ruler: the willingness to listen to harsh but necessary advice. The phrase 'cevi kaippa' literally means 'to be bitter to the ear', referring to words of criticism or correction. A king who possesses the character ('paṇpu') to bear ('poṟukkum') such words provides true protection. Consequently, the whole world ('ulaku') will willingly stay ('taṅkum') under his royal umbrella ('kavikai'), which serves as a traditional symbol of sovereign shelter and justice.

ai.literal: Giving, compassion, just rule, subjects protecting, all four he who possesses is to kings a light.
ai.translation: He who possesses all four traits—charity, compassion, a just rule, and the protection of his subjects—is a guiding light among kings.
ai.modern: கொடை, கருணை, நீதி தவறாத ஆட்சி, மக்களைப் பாதுகாத்தல் ஆகிய நான்கையும் உடையவன் அரசர்களுக்குள் ஒளி போன்றவன் ஆவான்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the four essential qualities of a great ruler. The word 'கொடை' means generosity in giving, while 'அளி' refers to a compassionate disposition towards others. 'செங்கோல்' literally means a straight scepter, symbolizing an unbiased and just administration, and 'குடி ஓம்பல்' is the active protection and care of the citizens. A ruler who embodies all these four traits stands out brilliantly, serving as a guiding light for all other kings to follow.
